role: Supporting induction rule in the admitted original-credit mechanism, not a new donor family or a new root assumption.
domain: Any admissible exactly paired-closed original W and the frozen selected saturated physical-bank rule at integer capacity H, with fixed physical keys and block ownership. Insert any finite collection of DELETE-only excursions at original operation boundaries, each restoring the complete physical A tree at that boundary. B never moves during such an excursion.
literal_quantity: Omega_H is total clipped unpaid cost over all actual original B doubles, evaluated at the policy's greatest cyclic fixed point. It is not a redefinition of the frozen U_int or UF residual.
theorem: Omega_H(W_with_excursions)<=Omega_H(W). The same domination holds for the coupled persistent global reserve at unchanged capacity and issuance parameters.
proof: A source excursion restores A exactly and B is frozen, so every base physical rotation, role priority and B demand is the same under the literal occurrence embedding.
Every added A unit resets some local banks to H and optionally adds nonnegative global supply. It cannot decrease any bank coordinate.
Every clipped base transition is monotone, including underfunded B steps. Its unpaid quantity is antitone in the input stock.
Thus the augmented period map dominates the base period map pointwise. Descending iteration from the common full box gives a greatest augmented cyclic balance at least the base greatest balance.

At every matched original B occurrence, augmented input stock dominates base input stock, so unpaid cost cannot increase. Sum the actual B occurrences once. The cyclic seam supplies no extra issuance.
resource_budget: All added A work is counted. The local selected bank keeps the old global issuance bound9H*A(W_with_excursions); a shared reserve keeps its separately proved allowance. No frame/scale sum or root-entry capacity assumption is used.
hard_witness_reduction: Closed DELETE loops inside maximal DELETE-only blocks may be erased to obtain a source with the same Q_B, no larger A and no smaller bank-unpaid cost. A hard bank witness may therefore be chosen without repeated complete A-tree states inside each such block. A cyclic source with KEEP can be cut after a KEEP using an explicitly admissible reaching prefix; all-DELETE sources have Q_B=0. The normalization is a constructive lossless reduction for both Universal CD and the global Omega_H<=K*A obligation, with the same constant. It supplies no uniform bound on irreducible gap length or on coupled A/B cycles.
not_claimed: An absolute Omega<=K*A bound for arbitrary W
Monotonicity of every historical paid partition or of the final UF residual
Arbitrary KEEP excursions can be erased without changing B demand
